Select molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name as molecule_name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds in document CHEMBL3039007. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, and left join compound_structures on molregno to include SMILES. Filter by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3039007'. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID.
